statusMeaning: The harness is repaired and smoke-verified. The formal envelope has NOT been launched and must not be launched before external review and explicit authorisation.
purpose: Prove that UCT-H-PREPARED makes exactly the same decisions as UCT-H-BASELINE under a workload that is fixed in COMPLETED SIMULATIONS (not in tree nodes and not in wall clock).

constantsRationale.COMPLETED_SIMULATIONS_PER_CALL: The experiment must compare a fixed AMOUNT OF SEARCH, not a fixed amount of tree growth. Under a node cap the two arms only run equally many simulations when they already agree, so the previous driver could not detect the divergence it claimed to test.
constantsRationale.MAX_NODES: Kept at the production value 500000. It is a safety net only: if it fires before K the call is an EXECUTION ANOMALY, never a shorter experiment.
constantsRationale.MAX_HANDOFFS: Frozen at the production horizon (4 action-right hand-offs).
constantsRationale.ROLLOUT_MODE: UCT-H is the arm under study; its rollout is the frozen hybrid policy in both arms.

seed.rule: Both arms of the same (root, repetition) cell MUST use the identical seed string. The arm identity is not part of the seed.
seed.note: uctSeed embeds an FNV-1a hash of `${rootId}:${algorithm}:${repetition}`; the two RNG streams are then derived from seedFor([seed,'chance']) and seedFor([seed,'policy']).

stopMechanism.name: maxCompletedSimulations
stopMechanism.evaluatedAt: the TOP of the simulation loop, i.e. after the previous simulation completed AND was backpropagated
stopMechanism.counterSemantics: `sims` is incremented only after `backprop` returns, so reaching K always means K complete simulations, each of which committed statistics.
stopMechanism.clock: now() => 0 and deadlineMs = 1 ⇒ deadlineAt = 1 ⇒ the deadline can never fire

executionAnomalies.policy: Any of these makes the call an EXECUTION ANOMALY. The cell is recorded and the run FAILS. K is NEVER silently lowered.

mustBeIdentical: per-simulation event sequence (via per-simulation SHA256 digest, in order)

whole search tree (node kind, hand-off depth, stateKey, visit count, total/mean reward, edge key + transition kind, CHANCE weights, per-outcome sample counter, per-outcome stateKey, CHANCE mass error)
node visit statistics (nodesCreated, chanceNodes, rootVisits, maxHandoffsReached)
final plan, planLength, planCost, treePlanLength, extensionSteps
allowedToDiffer: ruleCalls (the whole point: the prepared arm performs fewer rule transitions)

failureHandling.forensics: The driver re-runs the same (root, repetition, arm) with captureSimulation = <first divergent index> and capturePlan = true, and stores both arms' complete event bodies for that simulation plus both plan-phase digests.
failureHandling.noPartialCredit: A single divergent cell makes the experiment FAIL; the verdict is not averaged or re-run away.

determinismPolicy.mathRandom: Phase 1 installs a fixed-seed LCG stub for Math.random around the whole call and RESETS it per call, because exactly one impurity exists in the transition kernel: engine.catMove → sanitizeItemOverlaps relocates a butter that sits under the trap. The stub makes that draw reproducible on both arms.
determinismPolicy.ifDrawsAreNonZero: recorded as mathRandomDraws on the cell; the cell is still valid (both arms saw the same stub sequence) but the report must list those cells separately.
determinismPolicy.probeAnecdote: probe/impl/rolloutReuseParity.test.ts runs its whole corpus under a throw-on-call guard and asserts 0 draws, which is the evidence that the 24 frozen roots do not reach the impurity.

driver.isolation: spawnSync per repetition: the next fresh Node process starts only after the previous one has EXITED (HEAVY_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1, SERIAL_FRESH_REPETITIONS=TRUE)
outputs: PPC-MCTS-01B/data/phase1-formal/rep-NN.jsonl  (one record per (root), covering BOTH arms; appended, never truncated)
PPC-MCTS-01B/data/phase1-formal/ENVELOPE.json (written by the orchestrator: exit codes, wall times, per-rep validation)
driver.resume: Existing JSONL records are parsed and the corresponding (root, arm) cells are skipped. A pre-existing file is never deleted.
driver.perRepValidation: the orchestrator validates each repetition before starting the next: 24 records, 2 arm-calls each, K=200 per arm, seam reached, no node-cap/deadline stop, 0 aborted, 0 Math.random draws, 200 digests per arm and element-wise equality

smokeEvidenceStatus.label: SMOKE_NOT_EVIDENCE
smokeEvidenceStatus.shape: 2 roots x K=20 x 2 arms = 4 calls
smokeEvidenceStatus.role: proves the harness executes end to end; carries no evidential weight about parity
